desc: Dungeon master with an idle player (Aurora, no window): from the full run's segment 3 checkpoint in a co-op relay room, the host picks Dungeon master for player 2 (the guest, its controller there) and the guest presses nothing (into the rush's third fight: the first two bosses' scripts decide their own turns): the first enemy turn's choice waits 15 s, then the dungeon master's game says it is away and the computer plays the enemies (the host's game is told too, through the pick), every later turn at once, so the fights go on instead of stalling; later the guest presses A and gets the enemies back; the host stops the run as the Modes tab's Stop does, the room goes back to the adventure and both games agree again

log_must: \[dm\] The dungeon master is away: the enemies play themselves
\[together\] the party game is over: back to the adventure
\[dm\] no press from the dungeon master for 450 frames
\[dm\] The dungeon master is away: the enemies play themselves
\[dm\] The dungeon master is back: the enemies are yours again
